description: This Python source file defines a class WrapperModule that encapsulates a wrapped object type, handles torch modules with optional JIT compilation and saving, and provides a forward method for benchmarking. It is part of a framework for benchmarking overhead in a PyTorch-based project.

classes.name: WrapperModule
classes.description: A class that wraps a given object type for benchmarking, supporting graph mode tracing and optional saving of the torch scripted module.

methods.name: __init__(self, wrapped_type, module_config, debug, save=False)
methods.description: Initializes the WrapperModule instance with a wrapped type, module configuration, debug flag, and optional save flag. Sets up the module, tensors, and optionally traces and saves the module.

methods.name: forward(self, niters)
methods.description: Performs multiple forward passes through the module under torch.no_grad sentinel for benchmarking purposes.
